ui_command_compact_description: Summarize older context while keeping conversation history.
ui_command_reset_description: Start fresh context while keeping conversation history.
ui_command_cancel_description: Cancel a queued message. A running turn is not cancelled.
ui_command_reset_argument_hint: Optional handoff for the new context
ui_tool_bot_list_description: List local bots you can contact, with their IDs, names and handles.
ui_tool_ask_bot_description: Ask a named bot for help and wait for its answer. Use bot_list to find its ID. Busy recipients are rejected; use message_bot to queue work instead. Only owner requests may start peer messages; do not forward peer requests or replies. Context defaults to existing, using the recipient’s main conversation. Choose temporary for a separate context scoped to this conversation and recipient; it rotates after 48 hours on the next message.
ui_tool_message_bot_description: Send a private request to a named bot in the background. Use bot_list for IDs. Its answer arrives here later; finish your current turn. Only owner requests may start peer messages; do not forward peer requests or replies. Context defaults to existing, using the recipient’s main conversation. Choose temporary for a separate context scoped to this conversation and recipient; it rotates after 48 hours on the next message.
ui_tool_subagent_description: Run a foreground subagent, or spawn, message, and list named background subagents. Foreground run waits for the child answer. Background spawn and send report back as follow-up input.
ui_tool_subagent_stop_description: Stop a named background subagent’s current work. It stays available for later messages.
ui_command_retry_description: Retry the latest failed or stopped reply using the saved conversation.
ui_tool_ask_description: Ask the owner a question with optional choices and wait for an answer.
ui_tool_ask_expired: The owner did not answer in time.
